top_signals.title: Middle East Oil Markets Flash Signs of Abundance as Flows Rise
top_signals.summary: Middle East oil markets are indicating near-term supply is outpacing demand for the first time since July — when global prices plummeted after a temporary ceasefire between the US and Iran allowed tankers to exit the Persian Gulf through the Strait of Hormuz.
